criteria: Six complete, timed 1 hour 15 minute, 70-mark papers at the learner's tier (Biology 4.1-4.4 and 4.5-4.7; Chemistry 5.1-5.5 and 5.6-5.10; Physics 6.1-6.4 and 6.5-6.8)
At least one required-practical-based question answered correctly in each paper
Performance holds up across topics under mixed order, including Higher-only content at Higher tier
Extended answers use precise scientific vocabulary, and calculations show working and units
exam_rubric.pass_threshold: Foundation tier: performance consistent with grade 4-4 to 5-5 across full papers. Higher tier: performance consistent with grade 6-6 or above. AQA sets exact grade boundaries per series rather than a fixed mark table.
